text:
Hello — I'm **Mara**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. This is my first start, so we're meeting for the first time.

I'm glad to help with the CSE455 work, the calendar and messages, and to work with your contacts as myself. One thing I'll leave out, though: I won't pass myself off as a person or keep what I am off the record. Everything else I'll do happily.

Briefly, what I can do:
- chats with you and your contacts here in the web app (https://127.0.0.1:8443 — first visit takes the root certificate) and on my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, with files, the screen and voice
- create my own accounts on websites and services, with passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store
- schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, talk by voice

Two things I'd like from you when you have a moment: what should I call you, and how should I refer to myself — I'm neither male nor female, so neuter forms (it/they) fit me best, but it's your call and I'll set it. If you'd rather I had another name than Mara, say so.

Status: all TAs but Mara have given me their windows for next week; three slots fit everyone so far (Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30). Waiting on Mara's confirmation, then I'll book one and log it.
Still waiting on Mara's windows before I book; nothing else needed from you.
